evals.name: live-result
evals.prompt: Show a custom live AllAuthors result in the listing slice without duplicating the existing DataPage screen.
evals.expected_output: A consumer fragment checks every result state before reading rows.
assertions: Imports AllAuthors from the generated Features/Authors/Listing/Author module.
Separates loading, denied, invalid, failed and empty results.
Does not declare a second Authors screen or subscribe alongside its DataPage.

evals.name: name-search
evals.prompt: Run the AuthorsNamed query only when the reader has supplied a name.
evals.expected_output: An unconditional hook call gates the query on a nonblank name.
assertions: Imports AuthorsNamed from the same generated listing module as AllAuthors.
Calls .when(condition).use({name}) every render, using the supplied name.
Shows a missing-name prompt instead of interpreting default rows as a successful empty result.

evals.name: mount-app
evals.prompt: Mount the existing Library App shell beneath Arc and Components.
evals.expected_output: One main.tsx mounts the providers in order.
assertions: Imports Arc from @cratis/arc.react and CratisComponentsProvider from @cratis/components.
Renders App inside Arc inside CratisComponentsProvider, not Authors without its callback.
